# Business Document Analyzer

Paid, machine-readable business-document analysis API for AI agents.

## Endpoint

POST https://repoedu-1.onrender.com/analyze

Payment: x402 v2, exact scheme, Base Mainnet (eip155:8453), USDC, $0.50 per request.

Recipient:
0x031a713863890eb611776aadd48397873ed153ab

Input JSON:
{"text":"string"}

Output fields:
service, wordCount, characterCount, dates, monetaryAmounts, obligations, securitySignals, missingAreas, riskFlags

The endpoint advertises x402 Bazaar discovery metadata and a machine-readable input/output schema.

## Public metadata

GET https://repoedu-1.onrender.com/
GET https://repoedu-1.onrender.com/health
GET https://repoedu-1.onrender.com/openapi.json

## Payment behavior

An unpaid POST /analyze returns HTTP 402 with x402 payment requirements. A compatible x402 client should sign the requested USDC payment and retry the request.

## Limitations

Maximum input size is 50,000 characters. The current analysis is deterministic rule-based extraction; it does not call an external LLM.
